finding: No test covers the other side of the new `pid is None` guard: a stop given a pid whose pane close fails must still answer stopped true. If the guard were dropped, every test would still pass.
why: The settled rule S-234 says 'When the close fails, stopped stays true'. The only failed-close test sends a handle and no pid (line 678), and the pid-plus-handle test at line 636 closes the pane successfully, so the guard is never tested with a pid.
fix: Add a herdr test that kills a real child by pid with fake.fail["pane close"] = "error", and assert stopped is True, a method is present, and pane_closed is False.
evidence: herdr.py:315 `if pid is None and not closed:          # nothing was killed, and the agent runs on in its pane`; GRILL-LOG.md:669 `When the close fails, 'stopped' stays true, the answer names the pane`; test_team_transport.py:678 `body = mux("agent-stop", {"handle": pane})`
